name: KTM 390 Duke
summary: Flagship sub-500cc naked streetfighter featuring a 399cc liquid-cooled LC4c motor, adjustable WP APEX suspension, cornering ABS, traction control, and launch control.
aboutContent: The 2024-2026 KTM 390 Duke represents the ultimate performance benchmark in the single-cylinder motorcycle segment. Built around an all-new 2-piece trellis frame with a lightweight cast aluminium subframe, the 390 Duke delivers exceptional agility, aggressive ergonomic geometry, and razor-sharp steering dynamics.

Powering the machine is an upgraded 399cc LC4c motor delivering 45.3 bhp (46 PS) and 39 Nm of torque through a 6-speed transmission equipped with a power-assist slipper clutch and bi-directional quickshifter+. A 5-inch bonded glass TFT display offers Bluetooth connectivity, turn-by-turn navigation, and multiple riding modes (Street, Rain, Track).
